name: Herodias
description: Woman living at the time of the New Testament

points: Herodias had a quarrel against John and would have killed him, but could not, for Herod feared him, knowing that he was a just man and an holy.

note.label: Mark 6: A Prophet Without Honour, the Death of John, and the Five Thousand

points: Herod, being reproved by him for Herodias his brother Philip's wife, and for all the evils which he had done, added yet this above all, that he shut up John in prison.

note.label: Luke 3: The Preaching of John and the Generations Back to Adam

cases.name: Herod Antipas and Herodias
cases.charge: Taking his brother’s wife; beheading John for saying so
cases.preview: Herod the tetrarch had married Herodias, his brother Philip’s wife, and John told him plainly that it was not lawful for him to have his brother’s wife (Mark 6:17-18).
